kaikki_vikisozluk.e:
انخلعت (form VII)
# اِنْخَلَعْتُ (inḵalaʕtu) /in.xa.laʕ.tu/: first-person singular past active of اِنْخَلَعَ (inḵalaʕa)
# اِنْخَلَعْتَ (inḵalaʕta) /in.xa.laʕ.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of اِنْخَلَعَ (inḵalaʕa)
# اِنْخَلَعْتِ (inḵalaʕti) /in.xa.laʕ.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of اِنْخَلَعَ (inḵalaʕa)
# اِنْخَلَعَتْ (inḵalaʕat) /in.xa.la.ʕat/: third-person
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
